name: Kinetic Wraps of Strength (Greater)
text:
These tightly woven strips strengthen the hands and arms, allowing for the wearer to increase their application of force while lifting heavy loads, and shoving past blockades. Promise sculptors primarily use them to handle large blocks of stone, moving them around as they prepare to carve them. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks to force-open, reposition, and shove.

Activate—Burst of Might f (fortune, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt an Athletics check to Force Open, Reposition, or Shove

---
Effect You roll the skill check twice and take the better result.
